text: △のタイプは…「こうかが　いまひとつ」　×のタイプは…「こうかが　ない」　それいがいの　タイプは　こうかが　ふつうです。
note: △ and × come from the same Japanese rating marks as ◎: a triangle means "so-so, partly" and a cross means "no, wrong", as on school tests and in comparison tables.
claim: In Japan a triangle (△) is conventionally used to mean "so-so" or "partially acceptable" and a cross (×) to mean "wrong" or "bad".

check.quote: the triangle '△' (sankaku; 三角) means 'so-so' or 'partially applicable', and the '×' expresses disagreement.
